transportBoundary.desktopCore: Inherited device-local process pipes carry closed protocol fields and are never opened as a network listener.
transportBoundary.updates: Artifact downloads require an HTTPS release URL and send no workspace, repository, report, attachment, or goal data.
transportBoundary.auditStorage: Signed audit records are encrypted at rest with the owner-only local content key inside the single data root.

controls.auditRecord: signed workspace event envelope with actor, device, epoch, and timestamp

controls.auditRecord: content-free signed scan.run reliability event and immutable report identity

controls.leastPrivilege: Operations require an existing workspace scope and memory-only user-supplied passphrase material.
controls.auditRecord: content-free signed workspace.backup operation event with correlation ID

controls.leastPrivilege: Export accepts only a persisted validated report and a user-selected writable destination.
controls.auditRecord: content-free signed reports.export_word operation event with correlation ID

controls.leastPrivilege: Only closed, code-owned event kinds and identifiers are accepted; unknown serialized fields fail deserialization.
controls.auditRecord: signed content-free instrumentation.record and reliability.record events with stable identifiers
